clauses.requirement: For conformity of production under Annexes 4 and 5, in the case of a daytime running lamp intended for installation on category L3 vehicles whose designed maximum luminous intensity, as identified in Annex 1, does not exceed 7.00∙10^2 cd, 7.00∙10^2 cd shall be applied as the maximum luminous intensity (exception to the general rule in 6.1.3 that no measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from prescribed values). Applicable to the rear lamp only if a daytime running lamp function for L3 vehicles is present; otherwise not applicable to this M1 rear lamp.
The communication/approval information shall state the date on which the device was submitted for approval (Annex 1, item 5).
The communication shall identify the Technical Service responsible for conducting the approval tests (Annex 1, item 6).
The communication shall state the date of the report issued by the Technical Service (Annex 1, item 7).
The communication shall state the number of the report issued by the Technical Service (Annex 1, item 8).
The communication shall include a concise description of the device (Annex 1, item 9), with the sub-items that follow completed as applicable.
The concise description under Annex 1 item 9 shall be completed for the applicable device case (item 9.1 'In case of' followed by the specific device sub-items), as relevant to the lamp submitted.

In case of a rear-registration plate illuminating lamp, the concise description shall state the geometrical conditions of installation (position(s) and inclination(s) of the device in relation to the space to be occupied by the registration plate and/or different inclinations of this space). Applicable to the rear lamp only if a registration plate lamp function is included.
